description: Capital-city reference data keyed by the same 250 ISO-2/calendar codes as calendar-holidays/index.json. Toki Pona capital names are intentionally null for a later line-for-line translation pass.
coordinateNote: Latitude/longitude is a reproducible city reference point, not a legal city boundary or uniquely mandated geodetic point. GeoNames/current-reference corrections are used for missing, ambiguous, or changed capitals; remaining coordinates use the CountryInfo 0.1.2 Wikipedia-derived capital_latlng value as a fallback.

specialCaseVerification.name: Sri Lanka Ministry of Foreign Affairs

AQ.note: No national capital is assigned to Antarctica.

BI.note: Gitega is the political capital; Bujumbura is described by Burundi as the economic capital.

BO.note: Sucre is the constitutional capital; La Paz is the seat of government.

BQ.note: Caribbean Netherlands comprises separate special municipalities and has no single capital city.

BV.note: Bouvet Island is uninhabited and has no capital city.

GQ.note: Ciudad de la Paz became the capital on 2 January 2026, replacing Malabo.

GS.note: Grytviken is the conventional capital entry used by GeoNames; territorial administration is closely associated with King Edward Point and Stanley.

HM.note: Heard Island and McDonald Islands are uninhabited and have no capital city.

ID.note: Jakarta is retained as the current capital pending legal completion of the planned transfer to Nusantara.

LK.note: Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte is the administrative capital; Colombo is the commercial capital.

MS.note: Plymouth remains the conventional/de jure capital; government functions operate elsewhere after the volcanic evacuation.

NR.note: Nauru has no official capital; government offices are in Yaren District.

PS.note: East Jerusalem is recorded as the capital in the GeoNames Palestine country entry; the status of Jerusalem is politically disputed.

SZ.note: Mbabane is the administrative capital; Lobamba is the royal and legislative capital.

TK.note: Tokelau has no single national capital represented in the source country table.

UM.note: U.S. Minor Outlying Islands has no single capital city.

ZA.note: Pretoria is the administrative capital; Cape Town is legislative and Bloemfontein judicial.
